title: NOC Engineer / SRE
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>The <strong>SRE – NOC</strong> role sits at the intersection of <strong>traditional Network Operations Center (NOC)</strong> responsibilities and <strong>engineering‑driven reliability practices</strong>. This role focuses on <strong>24/7 service reliability, incident response, operational automation, and observability</strong>, while actively reducing operational toil through software and automation.</p> <p>Unlike a traditional NOC analyst, an SRE‑NOC is expected to <strong>engineer problems away</strong>, not just respond to alerts.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p><strong>Incident Response &amp; Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a <strong>primary or escalation responder</strong> in a 24x7 on‑call rotation</li> <li>Lead or support <strong>Major Incident (MI) response</strong>, including triage, mitigation, and resolution</li> <li>Coordinate across <strong>Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Product teams</strong></li> <li>Execute and improve <strong>runbooks, playbooks, and escalation paths</strong></li> <li>Drive <strong>blameless post‑incident reviews (PIRs)</strong> and track corrective actions</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Monitoring, Alerting &amp; Observability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own <strong>service health monitoring</strong> across infrastructure, applications, and dependencies</li> <li>Design and maintain <strong>alerting strategies</strong> that align with SLIs/SLOs</li> <li>Reduce alert fatigue through <strong>signal‑to‑noise improvements</strong></li> <li>Build dashboards using tools such as:</li> <ul> <li>Grafana</li> <li>Prometheus</li> <li>Datadog / Splunk / CloudWatch</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Reliability Engineering &amp; Automation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automate repetitive operational tasks to reduce manual toil</li> <li>Improve <strong>mean time to detect (MTTD)</strong> and <strong>mean time to resolve (MTTR)</strong></li> <li>Develop scripts and tools (Python, Bash, Go, etc.) to support NOC/SRE workflows</li> <li>Implement <strong>self‑healing and auto‑remediation</strong> where possible</li> <li>Partner with engineering teams to improve system design for reliability</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Platform &amp; Infrastructure Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support and troubleshoot:</li> <ul> <li>Linux‑based systems</li> <li>Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)</li> <li>Kubernetes / containerized environments</li> </ul> <li>Assist with capacity planning and availability reviews</li> <li>Ensure operational readiness for production releases</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong Linux systems administration</li> <li>Experience with <strong>incident management</strong> and production support</li> <li>Familiarity with:</li> <ul> <li>Cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)</li> <li>Containers &amp; orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)</li> <li>Monitoring/alerting platforms</li> </ul> <li>Scripting or programming experience in <strong>Python, Bash, Go, or similar</strong></li> <li>Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing)</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Operational</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working in <strong>24x7 NOC or production operations environments</strong></li> <li>Ability to handle high‑pressure incidents calmly and effectively</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication for incident coordination</li> <li>Comfort working from runbooks—but improving them when they fall short</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Preferred / Differentiators</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience defining or operating to <strong>SLOs / SLIs</strong></li> <li>Prior migration from <strong>traditional NOC → SRE model</strong></li> <li>Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)</li> <li>Exposure to <strong>security, compliance, or regulated environments</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Requisition ID: 11770.</p> <p>Reporting into: Manager, Network Operations.</p> <p>Role Type: Individual Contributor.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong>We are looking for a&nbsp;<strong>Senior&nbsp;&nbsp;software engineer&nbsp;</strong>who is passionate about solving infrastructure challenges through software engineering and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks that streamline cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.</p> <p>You will build programmatic infrastructure solutions using&nbsp;<strong>Python</strong>,&nbsp;<strong>Jinja2</strong>, and&nbsp;<strong>Terraform</strong>, generating and managing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) at scale. environments.</p> <p><strong>How Will You Make an Impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive infrastructure standardization and operational excellence by designing and developing scalable automation code reviews, sharing best practices, and continuously improving the quality, security, and maintainability of automation solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it <li>Strong understanding of Python packaging, virtual environments, dependency management (pip, Poetry), and code quality tooling (pylint, black, mypy)</li> <li>Experience building CLI tools and automation frameworks using Python (Click, Typer, or similar)</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Jinja2 templating — building reusable, parameterised templates for configuration and infrastructure code generation</li> <li>Experience with pytest for unit and integration testing of automation code</li> </ul> <p><strong>Terraform &amp; IaC Code Generation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong Terraform proficiency: module design, state management, remote backends, workspaces, and dependency graphs</li> <li>Proven experience generating Terraform HCL programmatically using Python and Jinja2 — building template-driven pipelines that produce valid, linted, plan-ready infrastructure code</li> <li>Familiarity with Terraform tooling: tflint, tfsec, terraform-docs, Terragrunt, or Atlantis</li> <li>Understanding of Terraform provider internals and resource lifecycle management</li> </ul> <p><strong>Puppet &amp; Configuration Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on Puppet experience: writing manifests and modules, Hiera data hierarchies, node classification, and r10k / Code Manager workflows</li> <li>Experience managing mixed Linux and Windows environments with Puppet at scale</li> <li>Familiarity with puppet-lint, rspec-puppet, and automated Puppet module testing pipelines</li> <li>Understanding of Puppet Enterprise or open-source Puppet Server administration</li> </ul> <p><strong>PowerShell Scripting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proficient PowerShell scripting for Windows Server administration, task automation, and hybrid cloud integrations (AWS Tools for PowerShell, GitLab CI)</li> <li>Comfortable working with Linux&nbsp;&nbsp;and Windows Server in production environments</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what's the role all about?</strong></p> <p>Here at <a href="https://www.nicepublicsafety.com/">NICE Public Safety</a>, we provide state of the art solutions for the Public Safety &amp; Justice market, providing software as a service for multi-media evidence management and Emergency Contact Centres to a worldwide customer base.</p> <p>We are currently expanding our Cloud Platform Engineering team to ensure we continue to offer exemplary service to our customers. This is a very hands-on role. You will be involved in ensuring our cloud platforms are observable, measurable, reliable, scalable, and maintainable. It’s likely that the successful candidate will have significant experience in a DevOps, SRE, Cloud Engineer, or Cloud Development role.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>NOTE – The successful candidate must have lived in the UK for 5 years and be eligible to obtain NPPV3 + Security Clearance.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as part of a team of SRE’s that act as the ‘gatekeepers’ of production and actively manage the work backlog and develop reliability improvements.</li> <li>Lead investigations into root cause outages, performance, and cost issues.</li> <li>Lead initiatives to develop the automation of low-value tasks balanced against project delivery demands.</li> <li>You will provide technical leadership and to wider Cloud Operations and Support teams along with providing oversight to the products and services they support.</li> <li>Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to establish and enforce SLOs, SLAs, and error budgets</li> <li>Develop and configure monitoring dashboards and alerts in tools like Grafana and Azure Monitor.</li> <li>Installation and configuration of Observability Platform including tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Open telemetry etc.</li> <li>Developing bicep modules for monitoring infrastructure and deploy it.</li> <li>Optimize system performance, cost, and security through regular reviews and tuning.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Do you have what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must have 6+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering</li> <li>Excellent technical, analytical and troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Experience and in-depth knowledge of databases and data handling (MS-SQL, Elasticsearch, YML, JSON, XML)</li> <li>Experience with Azure cloud</li> <li>Significant experience in programming or advanced scripting (Python, PowerShell, C# etc.)</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure/configuration as code and version control (ARM, BICEP, Git)</li> <li>Strong Experience managing monitoring, alerting and dashboarding platforms (Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch)</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of supporting live cloud services and platforms</li> <li>Expert in developing queries for dashboards and alerting for microservices.</li> <li>Expertise in developing custom metrics for microservices</li> <li>Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to establish and enforce SLOs, SLAs, and error budgets.</li> <li>Production experience with Kubernetes and containerization (AKS)</li> <li>Exposure to Azure DevOps pipelines is desirable (CI/CD)</li> <li>Strong experience in infrastructure as a code, design and implementation strategies.</li> <li>Experience with AI (tools) to automate and accelerate is a plus.</li> <li>Efficient, effective, and respectful communication skills both with customers and within internal departments. Including, <ul> <li>Good listener, able to identify and validate assumptions.</li> <li>Able to use effective questioning to confirm understanding of a customer problem and then provide help to solve it.</li> <li>Methodical troubleshooting, technical skill and attention to detail used in diagnosing problems and reproducing issues in a local environment.</li> <li>Multi-tasking and time-management to prioritise and switch between varied tasks.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Significant experience in platform engineering, observability, and provisioning.</li> <li>Proven ability to develop and implement a strategic vision for platform services, observability, and provisioning.</li> <li>Strong understanding of cyber security principles, governance, and compliance frameworks.</li> <li>Strong understanding and experience of cloud platforms, containerisation, and microservices architecture.</li> <li>Broad background across information technology with the ability to communicate clearly with non-security technical SMEs at a comfortable level.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in technical scoping, architecture design, and integration of security tools and processes.</li> <li>Ability to translate business needs into scalable, user-centric cloud solutions.</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a focus thought leadership and solution development.</li> <li>Experience in both operational and transformation roles or a clear working understanding of both perspectives.</li> <li>Knowledge of compliance with relevant frameworks, including ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials + or FEDRAMP</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tooling</strong></p> <ul> <li>Kubernetes (Ideally AKS)</li> <li>Azure Devops Pipelines</li> <li>Elasticsearch and Cloud Observability Stacks</li> <li>IAC (Bicep/Terraform)</li> <li>Powershell / C#</li> </ul> <p><strong>Beneficial Certifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>AZ 104</li> <li>AZ 305</li> <li>AZ 500</li> <li>AZ 700</li> <li>CKA</li> </ul> <p>Requisition ID: 10820<br>Reporting into: Director, Engineering,&nbsp;<br>Role Type: Individual Contributor</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

title: Telephony Network Engineer, TSM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a highly motivated Telephony Communications Engineer to join our team in the role of Technical Scrum Master (TSM) which combines deep technical engineering knowledge in Telephony Systems with leadership characteristics. In this position, you will be responsible for our fully integrated hosted and open Cloud vendors telephony systems platforms while also steering the team's agile processes, project roadmaps, and lab procurement. If you are looking to be part of a dynamic team working on exciting and industry-leading products, this is the job you’ve been looking for!</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing as a UC Engineer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support R&amp;D by covering the Unified-Communication/Call-Center integrations with our products and taking an active part in the research.</li> <li>Perform planning, design, configuration, implementation, operation, and optimization of lab Unified-Communication technologies.</li> <li>Develop and implement new telephony and Unified-Communication solutions based on a wide variety of different technologies.</li> <li>Proactively maintain knowledge and awareness of existing networks and applications, including Cisco, Microsoft, AVAYA, Oracle, AudioCodes, Ribbon Sonus and others.</li> <li>Assess requirements for VoIP/Unified-Communication/Call-Center technology initiatives and recommend appropriate solutions.</li> <li>Manage security lifecycles on the telephony and Unified-Communication products.</li> <li>Work with vendor support, management, and 3rd party partners, working according to change management processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing as a Technical Scrum Master (TSM):</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Sprint &amp; Task Management: Manage and prioritize the team's daily tasks and backlog in alignment with agile sprint methodologies.</li> <li>Roadmap &amp; Delivery: Collaborate directly with Product and R&amp;D CPE providers.</li> <li>Familiarity with voice and screen recording, contact-center technology, CTI integration, or audio analytics.</li> <li>Experience with resilience and high-availability design, title: Senior Legal Counsel
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Commerical Counsel on NiCE’s Americas Legal team, you will support high-value commercial and technology transactions that are central to NiCE’s customer experience business. The role is focused on enabling growth of NiCE’s CXone Mpower platform through the negotiation and structuring of complex technology, SaaS, and strategic partnership agreements. You will work closely with sales, product, finance, security, and privacy stakeholders to address issues at the intersection of cloud technology, data protection, and regulatory compliance, while providing practical, business-oriented legal guidance.</p> <p>In addition to transactional responsibilities, you will contribute to the development of scalable contracting processes, legal playbooks, and operational improvements to support a rapidly growing and evolving business. Reporting to the Associate General Counsel for NiCE Americas, this hybrid role requires two days per week in the office and offers the opportunity to operate as a trusted legal advisor within a global, AI-driven customer experience organization.</p> <p><strong>Personal Characteristics </strong></p> <p>We are seeking a senior legal professional who demonstrates the following attributes:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic and Commercial Mindset:</strong> Approaches legal issues with strong business judgment and creativity, delivering solutions that advance NiCE’s strategic and commercial objectives.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Partner:</strong> Works effectively across cross-functional and geographically diverse teams, building trust and influence with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.</li> <li><strong>Clear and Persuasive Communicator:</strong> Communicates complex legal concepts clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences.</li> <li><strong>Proactive Problem Solver:</strong> Manages multiple priorities with minimal supervision, anticipates risks, and drives matters to completion in a fast-paced, evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Adaptable and Resilient:</strong> Remains effective and composed amid change, ambiguity, and shifting business priorities.</li> <li><strong>Team-Oriented Professional:</strong> Values collaboration and contributes positively to a high-performing, engaged legal team culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Complex Transactions:</strong> Structure, negotiate, and manage sophisticated commercial and technology transactions across sales, product, and procurement, with a primary focus on enterprise cloud offerings.</li> <li><strong>Provide Legal and Regulatory Guidance:</strong> Advise on U.S. and international legal issues related to SaaS, data protection, cybersecurity, and commercial contracting, delivering practical, risk-balanced guidance to the business.</li> <li><strong>Scale Legal Operations:</strong> Develop, maintain, and improve legal playbooks, templates, and contracting processes to increase efficiency and support a growing, fast-moving organization.</li> <li><strong>Partner Cross-Functionally:</strong> Collaborate with legal colleagues and cross-functional stakeholders globally to align legal strategies with business priorities and key initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Anticipate Regulatory Change:</strong> Monitor and assess evolving laws and regulations affecting NiCE’s commercial activities and proactively advise on risk mitigation and compliance.</li> <li><strong>Enable the Business:</strong> Educate and train internal teams on legal, compliance, and contracting best practices to support informed and efficient decision-making.</li> <li><strong>Build Trusted Relationships:</strong> Establish strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners, balancing legal risk with commercial objectives.</li> <li><strong>Support Strategic Growth:</strong> Contribute to initiatives that advance NiCE’s global growth strategy and innovation agenda.</li> <li><strong>Support Procurement and Vendor Contracting:</strong> Negotiate and advise on a broad range of inbound procurement, vendor, marketing, software, and other enterprise purchasing agreements, balancing legal risk with operational and business needs in a large, global organization.</li> <li><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Other Legal Matters:</strong><strong> Support additional legal projects and responsibilities as needed.</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Education and Licensing:</strong> Juris Doctor with strong academic credentials and an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.</li> <li><strong>SaaS and Technology Experience:</strong> Minimum of 8 to 10 years of legal experience, with substantial experience supporting SaaS, cloud computing, and enterprise software transactions primarily on the vendor side.</li> <li><strong>Transactional Expertise:&nbsp;</strong>Demonstrated experience drafting, negotiating, and advising on complex SaaS and technology agreements, including Data Processing Agreements and, where applicable, Business Associate Agreements.</li> <li><strong>Legal Acumen:</strong> Strong working knowledge of data privacy, cybersecurity, and intellectual property law, including familiarity with U.S. and international data protection regimes and evolving regulatory trends.</li> <li><strong>In-House Experience:</strong> Prior in-house legal experience supporting a commercial or technology-driven business environment.<strong>&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Public Company or Global Environment:</strong> Experience supporting a U.S. publicly traded company and/or a global, multinational organization.</li> <li><strong>Operational Maturity:</strong> Proven ability to design, improve, and scale legal processes, templates, and playbooks in support of a growing business.</li> <li><strong>AI and Emerging Technology Law:</strong> Familiarity with evolving artificial intelligence and automated decision-making laws and regulations in the United States and internationally, including emerging global frameworks such as the EU AI Act.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent negotiation, drafting, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal issues into practical business guidance.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills and sound judgment, with the ability to manage multiple matters independently in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Collaborative, team-oriented approach with the ability to build effective working relationships across functions, regions, and cultures.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to raise the bar constantly, you may be our next NiCEr!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Requisition ID: </strong>&nbsp;<br><strong>Reporting into: </strong>Director, AGC<br><strong>Role Type: </strong>Senior</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. title: Associate Technical Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></span></p> <p>NICE Public Safety provides a cloud based enterprise product used by public safety and justice agencies. Our customers depend on this product for time sensitive work, so the system has to be available at all times.</p> <p>We are looking for an Associate Technical Support Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team in Pune. This is an early career role for someone with 1 to 3 years of experience who wants to build a strong foundation in cloud monitoring and production support. The main purpose of the role is to watch the health of our product hosted on Microsoft Azure, respond to alerts, carry out first level troubleshooting and escalate issues to senior engineers with clear and complete information.</p> <p>The person will work under the guidance of senior Technical Support Engineers and is expected to learn quickly, follow established SOPs and gradually take on more ownership. We also expect them to be curious about AI tools such as Claude and Copilot and willing to use them in their daily work.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Monitor production systems on Azure using tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana and Kibana.</li> <li>Watch alert queues and dashboards, acknowledge alerts promptly and act on them as per the defined SOPs.</li> <li>Carry out first level troubleshooting by reviewing logs, metrics and recent changes, and document findings clearly.</li> <li>Raise and track incidents in the ticketing tool, escalate to senior engineers or Advanced Support on time and with complete information.</li> <li>Assist senior engineers during major incidents by gathering logs, running health checks and keeping notes.</li> <li>Help reduce false alarms by reporting noisy or misfiring alerts to the senior team.</li> <li>Use AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to help read logs, summaries incidents and draft updates.</li> <li>Write simple scripts to automate routine tasks such as reports and health checks, with guidance from senior engineers.</li> <li>Share clear and timely updates with internal stakeholders during incidents.</li> <li>Follow and help update SOPs, knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li>Meet the defined SLAs, KPIs and escalation processes.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></span></p> <p></p> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience in technical support, application support, NOC, production monitoring or cloud operations.</li> <li>Basic hands on exposure to Microsoft Azure and at least one monitoring or logging tool such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana or Kibana.</li> <li>Basic understanding of cloud concepts, web applications and how client server systems work.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Windows or Linux, including reading logs and checking services and processes.</li> <li>Basic scripting ability in PowerShell, Python or Shell, or a strong willingness to learn.</li> <li>Familiarity with a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow or Jira.</li> <li>Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or ChatGPT for day to day technical work.</li> <li>Good written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to explain a technical issue clearly to a senior engineer or a customer.</li> <li>Eager to learn, takes feedback well and follows processes carefully.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field (BE, BTech or BSc).</li> <li>Exposure to KQL queries in Log Analytics.</li> <li>Basic knowledge of REST APIs and how to test them.</li> <li>Awareness of Docker, Kubernetes or CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or ITIL Foundation certification.</li> <li>Interest in AI tools, prompt writing or building small automations.</li> <li>This role works in rotational shifts aligned to US time zones, including night shifts.</li> <li>The person will be part of a weekend on-call rotation shared across the team.</li> <li>The role is based in our Pune office and works with global teams.</li> <li>Work on a product that public safety and justice agencies rely on every day.</li> <li>Learn from experienced engineers and get hands on with the latest monitoring, automation and AI tools.</li> <li>Clear growth path to Technical Support Engineer and onward to Advanced Support, SRE, Cloud Operations or AI Operations.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</span></p> <p><strong>Requisition ID:11916</strong><br><strong>Reporting into:</strong> Tech Manager&nbsp;<br><strong>Role Type:</strong> Individual Contributor</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. title: Specialist Software Engineer ( AI Architect , Developement )
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder (SPARK)</h1> <h2>So, what’s the role all about?</h2> <p>NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for the senior technical voice and hands-on builder at its core.</p> <p>As Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, you will set the technical direction for SPARK and build alongside the team. You will advise on the tech stack, choose the patterns and tools we standardise on, and write the code for flagship prototypes yourself. You will also advise business and technology leaders on what is feasible, what is wise, and what to build next.</p> <p>This is a consultative and autonomous role. You are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, making sound technical decisions with minimal supervision, and explaining your reasoning to engineers and executives alike. You will be the senior technical lead for the SPARK AI Architects &amp; Builders.</p> <h2>How will you make an impact?</h2> <p>You will own the technical architecture of SPARK and the quality of what it ships, from the first prototype to the enterprise-grade tool, working hands-on with the Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, the Business Analyst, and NiCE’s platform, security, and architecture teams.</p> <h3>Set Technical Direction</h3> <ul> <li>Recommend and own the SPARK tech stack: models and providers, agent and orchestration frameworks, retrieval and vector storage, integration patterns, and developer tooling</li> <li>Make build-versus-buy and platform-versus-custom decisions, and record them in clear architecture decision records</li> <li>Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so every new idea starts from a paved path instead of a blank page</li> <li>Track the fast-moving AI landscape and bring forward the models, tools, and protocols worth adopting</li> <li>Ensure build allows tools to be migrated easily.</li> <li>Always ensure cost optimization is included into the design.</li> </ul> <h3>Build Hands-On</h3> <ul> <li>Design and build agentic AI solutions, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, memory, multi-agent coordination, and human-in-the-loop controls</li> <li>Build RAG pipelines and integrations with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365, using APIs and MCP</li> <li>Ensure solution design incorporates NiCE guidelines on Ethics, Risk, compliance</li> <li>Review data and infrastructure readiness of the solutions</li> <li>Write clean, tested, documented code that others can pick up and extend</li> <li>Turn ideas into working prototypes quickly, and into demonstrable value for the business teams who proposed them</li> </ul> <h3>Take Prototypes to Enterprise Grade</h3> <ul> <li>Define what enterprise-grade means for SPARK: security, access control, privacy, reliability, scalability, observability, and cost</li> <li>Harden prototypes for global rollout, including CI/CD, automated tests, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and rollback</li> <li>Establish LLM evaluation practices: test sets, regression tests, hallucination checks, and quality dashboards</li> <li>Work with Security, Legal, and Architecture teams to embed responsible AI and data protection requirements into every design</li> </ul> <h3>Advise and Lead</h3> <ul> <li>Act as trusted technical adviser to business teams, the Project Manager, and senior leaders on feasibility, trade-offs, effort, and risk</li> <li>Review designs and code, mentor the Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, and raise the engineering bar across the team</li> <li>Work with minimal supervision, flag risks early, and make good decisions when requirements are still moving</li> <li>Collaborate with NiCE’s internal/ external AI platform and architecture teams so SPARK solutions fit the wider enterprise AI strategy</li> </ul> <h2>Have you got what it takes?</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred), or equivalent experience</li> <li>10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years designing and delivering LLM-powered or agentic AI systems in production</li> <li>Expert, hands-on skills in Python and/or TypeScript; you are still a developer who writes code every week</li> <li>Deep experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent), tool-integration protocols such as MCP, and RAG architectures with vector databases</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of LLM providers and APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, and open-source models), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation</li> <li>Experience with at least one major cloud AI ecosystem (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and with REST API, event-driven, and microservice design</li> <li>Strong grasp of security, privacy, and responsible AI practices for enterprise systems</li> <li>Proven ability to work independently, advise stakeholders, and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to executives and non-technical colleagues</li> <li>Fluency in English</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in an AI centre of excellence, innovation lab, or internal incubator</li> <li>Experience with Cognigy, NiCE CXone, or other CCaaS and conversational AI platforms, including voice AI</li> <li>Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Atlassian, and Microsoft 365</li> <li>Experience with LLMOps: evaluation frameworks, observability (OpenTelemetry), prompt registries, and cost governance</li> <li>Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source models</li> <li>Experience with workflow applications such as N8N or similar</li> <li>Have developed market ready software applications</li> <li>Fluency in foreign language; German would be a plus, for close collaboration with Forward Deployment Cognigy team in Germany.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s in it for you?</h2> <p>SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.</p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!</p> <h2>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</h2> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</p> <p><strong>Requisition ID: </strong>11874</p> <p><strong>Reporting into: </strong>VP , Business Operations , Sales Ops</p> <p><strong>Role Type</strong> : Individual Contributor</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Architect , Development)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><h2>So, what’s the role all about?</h2> <p>NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for builders who understand the business as well as the code.</p> <p>As Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, you will design and build the AI solutions that SPARK brings to life. You combine real business knowledge with solid software engineering: you understand how sales, service, support, and operations teams actually work, and you know how to take an idea through the full software development lifecycle to a solution people use every day.</p> <p>You will work as part of a small team of senior builders, led by the Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, with significant ownership of the solutions you deliver. You will partner closely with the Business Analyst and the Project Manager.</p> <h2>How will you make an impact?</h2> <p>You will design and build the AI solutions at the heart of SPARK, owning them from the first prototype through hardening and handover, working with the Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder, the Business Analyst, and the Project Manager.</p> <h3>Design Solutions that Fit the Business</h3> <ul> <li>Work with the Business Analyst and business teams to understand the process, the users, and the outcome, and shape a solution design that fits how people actually work</li> <li>Translate use cases into solution architectures covering agents, retrieval, integrations, data flows, and user experience</li> <li>Choose the right approach for each problem, whether that is an AI agent, a workflow automation, a prompt-based assistant, or a conventional software fix</li> <li>Estimate effort and flag technical risks early to the Project Manager</li> </ul> <h3>Build and Ship</h3> <ul> <li>Build working prototypes and production-grade solutions using LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and RAG pipelines</li> <li>Work with IT to develop integrations, APIs, and services that connect AI solutions to enterprise systems such as Salesforce, Snowflake, Power BI, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365</li> <li>Apply prompt engineering and context design that deliver reliable results, and iterate on user feedback</li> <li>Write clean, tested, documented code and keep it in well-organised shared repositories</li> <li>Optimize solution costs</li> </ul> <h3>Engineer for Quality and Scale</h3> <ul> <li>Apply the full SDLC to every solution (design, build, test, release, and support), using Git workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Build automated evaluations and regression tests so quality is measured, not assumed</li> <li>Add logging, monitoring, and cost tracking so solutions can be run and supported in production</li> <li>Follow the security, privacy, and responsible AI standards set with the Senior Technical AI Architect &amp; Builder and NiCE’s security teams</li> <li>Ensue audit trails are included and follow the discussed solutions on agreed guardrails measure.</li> </ul> <h3>Hand Over and Improve</h3> <ul> <li>Prepare documentation, runbooks, and demos for the Support Helpdesk, the Change Management &amp; Evangelist, and the business teams who will use each solution</li> <li>Use feedback and recurring support issues to fix, improve, and extend solutions after launch</li> <li>Share patterns and reusable components that make the next build faster</li> </ul> <h2>Have you got what it takes?</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>6-8 years of software development experience across the full SDLC, building enterprise-grade, scalable software</li> <li>2+ years of hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, such as RAG pipelines, agents, tool use, or prompt-engineered assistants</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, with strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and async or event-driven design</li> <li>Solid business knowledge: experience working closely with functions such as sales, customer service, operations, or finance, and the ability to turn their needs into working software</li> <li>Experience with at least one agent or orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent) and with vector databases or search</li> <li>Practical experience with a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)</li> <li>Solid Git workflow, code review, testing, and CI/CD practices</li> <li>Ability to work with autonomy in a small, fast-moving team with evolving requirements</li> <li>Fluency in English</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience implementing MCP servers or clients, and integrating with enterprise systems</li> <li>Familiarity with the Anthropic Claude API and tool-use patterns</li> <li>Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments, with exposure to Cognigy or NiCE CXone</li> <li>Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and observability tooling</li> <li>Experience with low-code or agent-building platforms such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio</li> <li>Experience in workflow applications such as N8N or similar</li> </ul> <h2>What’s in it for you?</h2> <p>SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.</p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!</p> <h2>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</h2> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</p> <p><strong>Requisition ID- </strong>11875<strong><br>Reporting into: </strong>VP, Business Operations<br><strong>Role Type: </strong>Individual Contributor</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p> <p><strong>Why this role matters now</strong></p> <p>This role sits at the centre of our AI-led delivery transformation. We are rebuilding our digital evidence platform as AI-Native, with AI tooling acting as a daily partner from design through verification. The right architect is not someone with a long list of AI credentials - AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. The right architect is someone who already uses AI in their daily work, has formed clear judgement about where it belongs and where it does not, and is curious enough to learn the next tool when their current one is superseded.</p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a talented Architect and Software Developer to join our team. You must:</p> <ul> <li>Be able to communicate effectively, including via email, instant message, phone, and video conferencing tools.</li> <li>Be fierce in your pursuit of product quality.</li> <li>Be an excellent problem solver with an active interest in the latest design and development tools and technologies.</li> <li>Be knowledgeable and enthusiastic about process.</li> <li>Be practically fluent with AI tooling - using Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent in your daily work, not just experimentally. We will discuss specific examples at interview.</li> <li>Be able to recognize opportunities for optimization and enhancement of process, product architecture and delivery based on the evolutions in AI.</li> <li>Have clear judgement about where AI belongs in a public-safety platform, and where it does not.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p>You will be responsible using a collaborative, team-based approach.</li> <li>Ensuring the architecture takes into account the concerns of security, scalability, compatibility, maintainability — and the responsible, evidenced use of AI in both build-time and run-time.</li> <li>Performing testing of your work, fixing defects, and helping to resolve customer support cases.</li> <li>Ensuring that the team adheres to the architectural direction and standards.</li> <li>Mentoring and coaching team members in architecture practices, AI-led delivery techniques, and the discipline of validating AI outputs.</li> <li>Liaising with Product Management during planning sessions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid experience developing applications in C# using Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code.</li> <li>Proven track record of breaking down complex market requirements into secure, scalable and resilient system designs.</li> <li>Experience with multi-tenant cloud solutions.</li> <li>Experience working in collaborative multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience creating maintainable code and using source control solutions such as DevOps, GIT or similar.</li> <li>Experience of unit testing, code reviews, and other product quality disciplines.</li> <li>Solid understanding of the principles of network security, authentication, and authorization.</li> <li>Experience of working with databases using Entity Framework or similar.</li> <li>Good knowledge of SOLID principles.</li> <li>Experience creating RESTful APIs and ensuring API extensibility.</li> <li>Recent practical experience using AI tooling (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent) in your daily work, not just experimentation. Comfortable describing what worked, what did not, and what you decided.</li> <li>Output discipline: you remain accountable for the architecture you are responsible for, whatever helped you produce it.</li> <li>Comfort with probabilistic systems, and clear judgement about when to use AI in a high-trust domain.</li> <li>Learning velocity: able to ramp on a new AI tool or technique in days, not months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Security best practice (OWASP top ten)</li> <li>Azure SQL Server</li> <li>DevOps, Pipelines, TeamCity, GitHub</li> <li>Windows services</li> <li>Experience using AI tooling specifically in the architect role - for design review, ADR drafting, threat modelling, contract design, or similar.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-Native software patterns (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, prompt-and-response evaluation, evidence packets).</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we do not require</strong></p> <p>We do not require you to be an AI expert. AI moves too fast for credentials to mean much. We require curiosity, recent practical use, output discipline, and the judgement to ship under accountability.</p> <p><strong>About the interview process</strong></p> <p>The final stage includes a working session using our AI tooling. title: Senior Business Analyst, AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Business Analyst, AI</h1> <h2>So, what’s the role all about?</h2> <p>NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Your idea. Our spark.</p> <p>As Business Analyst in the SPARK team, you will be the bridge between the people who have the ideas and the architects and builders who make them real. You will shape raw ideas into clear, prioritised, buildable use cases, and make sure what we build solves the problem it was meant to solve.</p> <p>This is a business analysis role with a technical edge. You come from a programming background, so you can read code, query data, test an API, and prototype a quick proof of concept, and you can still run a room full of non-technical stakeholders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the AI Architects &amp; Builders, and the Change Management &amp; Evangelist.</p> <h2>How will you make an impact?</h2> <p>You will own the front end of the incubation pipeline, from the first conversation about an idea through to accepted, measurable outcomes, working hands-on with business teams, architects, and delivery colleagues across regions.</p> <h3>Discover and Shape Ideas</h3> <ul> <li>Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want</li> <li>Turn ideas into clear use case briefs covering the problem statement, users, expected value, data needs, risks, and success measures</li> <li>Assess and rank ideas against business value, feasibility, data readiness, effort, and risk, and give the team a clear recommendation on what to build next</li> <li>Build lightweight business cases, including estimated time saved, quality gains, and cost or revenue impact for presentation to Management and AI steering committee</li> </ul> <h3>Define What Gets Built</h3> <ul> <li>Map as-is and to-be processes, and identify where an AI agent, an automation, or a human-in-the-loop step fits best</li> <li>Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that architects and builders can build from without guesswork</li> <li>Specify expected AI behaviour: what the solution should do, what it should never do, when it hands over to a person, and how answers will be checked for quality</li> <li>Prepare test scenarios and evaluation datasets with the builders to measure accuracy, reliability, and usefulness before launch</li> <li>Update initiative register</li> </ul> <h3>Prototype and Validate</h3> <ul> <li>Use SQL, Python, or low-code tools to analyse process data, test assumptions, and build simple prototypes that prove an idea before engineering effort is committed</li> <li>Review APIs and system documentation to confirm integration feasibility with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365</li> <li>Gather early user feedback on prototypes and turn it into prioritised backlog items</li> </ul> <h3>Support Delivery and Adoption</h3> <ul> <li>Own and groom the product backlog, and take part in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives</li> <li>Plan and run user acceptance testing with business users, and manage defects and feedback through to closure</li> <li>Partner with the Change Management &amp; Evangelist and the Support Helpdesk to turn user questions and feedback into clear improvements</li> </ul> <h3>Measure and Share Value</h3> <ul> <li>Capture baseline metrics before launch and track results afterwards, so every solution can show real impact</li> <li>Understand the Software Development Lifecylse to review adoption, continuous business iteration and value realization.</li> <li>Maintain the use case library, requirement templates, and playbooks that make the next idea faster to shape</li> </ul> <h2>Have you got what it takes?</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>5-8 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst in a software, technology, or digital transformation environment</li> <li>A programming background: hands-on experience writing code in at least one language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#, plus working knowledge of SQL and REST APIs</li> <li>Proven skill in requirements engineering: process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability from need to delivered outcome</li> <li>Experience facilitating workshops and aligning senior business stakeholders with technical teams</li> <li>Experience working in Agile teams, with tools such as Jira and Confluence</li> <li>Working understanding of how large language models, RAG, and AI agents work and what they can and cannot do reliably, with hands-on use of AI assistants in your own work</li> <li>Some finance background or knowledge will be a plus</li> <li>Strong analytical, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical ideas in plain business language</li> <li>Fluency in English</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience on AI, GenAI, or automation projects, from use case definition through to production</li> <li>Experience with low-code or agent-building tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot Studio or similar</li> <li>Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS environments</li> <li>Familiarity with evaluating LLM output quality, including test set design and acceptance thresholds</li> <li>Business analysis certification such as CBAP or PMI-PBA</li> <li>Experience working across regions and time zones, with teams in International and the Americas</li> </ul> <h2>What’s in it for you?</h2> <p>SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.</p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!</p> <h2>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</h2> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.</p> <p><strong>Requisition ID: </strong>11870</p> <p><strong>Reporting into: </strong>Jean Lee</p> <p>&nbsp;Vice President, Business Operations. and screen recording, playback and analysis for Security customers worldwide.</p> <p>We are currently expanding our development team to allow us to continue to develop an exciting product that enables title: Senior AI Evangelist & Developer Advocate, Agentic AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">So,&nbsp;what’s&nbsp;the role all about?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>As Senior AI Evangelist &amp; Developer Advocate within NiCE's Agentic AI line of business, you will bring our products and the wider agentic AI story to life in content and on stage. You work proactively and independently: you research topics yourself, align with stakeholders, and draw on internal and external sources for constant inspiration. You then produce the content yourself, from video and demos to presentations and webinars.</p> <p>The role sits within Product Marketing and works closely with Product, Engineering, NiCE Labs and Marketing. A large part of it is agentic building: creating AI agents, demos and prototypes with coding agents such as Claude Code, through the Cognigy plugin and with other vibe coding tools. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to be deeply hands-on and able to build things that work. The AI market moves faster than any market before it, and this role is built for that speed.</p> <p>You bring an AI-first mindset and real technical depth. You can explain sophisticated technology in a simple, compelling way, and you use AI tools throughout your own workflow to raise both speed and quality.</p> <p>Success in this role means a steady stream of differentiated content that builds NiCE Cognigy's credibility in agentic AI, grows our audience, and supports launches and revenue teams with assets they want to use. All of it is aligned with our overall product marketing strategy and company goals.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">How will you make an impact</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Build an AI-first evangelism practice for NiCE Cognigy at the level of the top global players, covering launches, thought leadership and fast responses to market developments</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of agentic AI, voice AI and AI tooling: test new developments early and assess what matters for our market</li> <li>Build AI agents, demos and prototypes yourself with Cognigy, coding agents and vibe coding tools</li> <li>Partner early with Product and NiCE Labs on the roadmap, and translate new capabilities into clear value stories</li> <li>Write, record and edit video content, from short capability clips to launch videos and build-along walkthroughs</li> <li>Create high-impact presentations, and present at webinars, conferences, podcasts and customer and analyst engagements</li> <li>Engage the builder and developer community through content, live demos and events, and bring their feedback back to Product</li> <li>Keep narratives consistent with Analyst Relations, Competitive Intelligence, PR and Sales Enablement</li> <li>Provide revenue teams with demo videos, decks and assets that make complex capabilities easy to understand</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Have you got what it takes?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>English at native or near-native level, written and spoken. German is a plus.</li> <li>Based in DACH, ideally Berlin or Düsseldorf. Remote within DACH is possible, with travel to events and our offices.</li> <li>A proven body of public work, such as YouTube videos, podcast episodes, conference talks, webinars or livestreams, that you created and presented yourself</li> <li>Hands-on experience with agentic building and vibe coding: you build working agents, apps and prototypes with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable or n8n, and you're comfortable with APIs, integrations and enough code to get things running</li> <li>Strong technical understanding of AI and SaaS products, and the ability to translate capabilities into customer value</li> <li>Speed and agility: you can move from idea to published, polished content within hours, with a repeatable workflow to do so consistently</li> <li>Excellent storytelling and visual skills, with a high standard for slides, scripts and video, and confidence presenting to technical and business audiences, live and on camera</li> <li>Proven ability to own initiatives end to end, from strategy through execution</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work across product, marketing and sales teams</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;<br></span></p> <p><strong>How to apply</strong></p> <p>Please include links to 3–5 examples of content you created and appear in, such as videos, podcast episodes, talk recordings, demos or repositories. We review these first, and applications without them cannot be considered.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s&nbsp;in it for you?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Join an innovative, fast-growing organization at the forefront of agentic AI for customer experience. You will have early access to new products, real influence over how NiCE Cognigy's story is told, and the freedom to shape the evangelism practice your way. You will work alongside high-performing teams in a collaborative and dynamic environment, with strong opportunities for growth and impact.</p> <p>If you are passionate about AI, love building things and know how to turn them into content people want to watch, this could be your next big opportunity at NiCE.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">About NiCE </span></span></strong><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">Cognigy</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">NiCE</span> <span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)">Cognigy</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="Normal (Web)"> delivers AI that works—fast, human, and enterprise-ready. title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><h1>Senior Technical Account Manager</h1> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Location: Remote, USA</strong></p> <h3>So, what’s the role all about?</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As a <strong>Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM)</strong> at NiCE, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor and advocate for some of our most complex CXone customers. You will begin engaging with customers prior to go-live and maintain ownership of the relationship throughout their journey, helping ensure they successfully adopt, optimize, and realize value from their CXone solutions.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will combine strategic account management with advanced technical problem-solving, working closely with customers to understand their contact center environments, resolve complex challenges, prevent escalations, and identify opportunities to improve their overall experience. Internally, you will partner across Technical Support, Professional Services, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and other teams to drive customer outcomes.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As a senior member of the TAM organization, you will also serve as a technical and customer-management leader, mentoring other TAMs, sharing best practices, and helping improve processes across the organization.</p> <h3>How will you make an impact?</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned strategic and complex customer accounts.</li> <li>Build strong customer relationships through regular engagement focused on business objectives, technical environments, open issues, product usage, and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Lead customers through go-live preparation and help establish confidence and success as they transition into production.</li> <li>Take ownership of complex technical issues and customer escalations, coordinating resources across Technical Support, Professional Services, Product Management, Engineering, and other teams through resolution.</li> <li>Perform advanced troubleshooting and technical triage while helping customers navigate complex contact center and CXone environments.</li> <li>Ensure customer issues, cases, and requests progress appropriately and remain within established SLA and OLA expectations.</li> <li>Maintain a deep understanding of each customer's technical environment and business objectives to proactively identify needs, risks, and opportunities.</li> <li>Drive customer satisfaction, retention, adoption, and referenceability across assigned accounts.</li> <li>Develop and deliver customized customer presentations demonstrating product usage, realized value, achievements, opportunities, and recommended next steps.</li> <li>Provide technical and product training that enables customers to maximize the value of their NiCE CXone investment.</li> <li>Communicate confidently and professionally with technical, business, and executive stakeholders, including during high-pressure or escalated situations.</li> <li>Identify potential escalations early and coordinate the appropriate internal resources to prevent or resolve them.</li> <li>Develop business cases that clearly define customer challenges, business impact, proposed solutions, and expected outcomes.</li> <li>Maintain accurate and timely customer, account, activity, and case information within CRM systems.</li> <li>Capture and share technical knowledge, best practices, and repeatable solutions through knowledge-base content and internal training.</li> <li>Mentor and coach TAMs and other team members in technical troubleshooting, customer management, escalation handling, and best practices.</li> <li>Serve as a subject matter expert across multiple technical areas and help develop technical capabilities across the broader TAM organization.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering teams to communicate customer feedback, product issues, and enhancement opportunities.</li> <li>Identify and lead projects and initiatives that improve processes, customer experience, operational efficiency, and overall team performance.</li> <li>Serve as a resource for struggling or escalated accounts and help develop strategies that return those customers to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Work primarily during customers' core business hours, with occasional extended or after-hours support as customer needs require.</li> <li>Travel up to 25% for customer meetings, site visits, and company events.</li> </ul> <h3>Have you got what it takes?</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.</li> <li>10+ years of experience in technical services, software, telecommunications, customer service, contact center technology, and/or service delivery.</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing complex customer relationships in technical environments.</li> <li>Strong technical problem-solving, analytical, triage, and advanced troubleshooting skills.</li> <li>Working technical knowledge of contact center software, architecture, design, and functionality.</li> <li>Experience resolving complex and high-impact technical and customer issues.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.</li> <li>Strong customer-service orientation and the ability to establish trusted-advisor relationships.</li> <li>Ability to communicate calmly, confidently, and professionally during escalations and other high-pressure customer situations.</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with technical and business teams to drive issues through resolution.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer needs in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound professional judgment, and drive projects through completion.</li> <li>Experience communicating technical and functional concepts while maintaining strong business relationships.</li> <li>Strong understanding of contact center operations, KPIs, and industry best practices.</li> <li>Ability to train, mentor, present, and share technical knowledge effectively with customers and colleagues.</li> <li>Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience maintaining customer information within CRM systems.</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Experience with NiCE CXone or similar cloud contact center/CCaaS platforms.</li> <li>Advanced knowledge of telecommunications, contact center, and IP telephony technologies.</li> <li>TCP/IP networking knowledge and experience with internet and network fundamentals.</li> <li>Experience with VoIP technologies and SIP signaling.</li> <li>Understanding of network topology and telecommunications architecture, including PBX and carrier environments.</li> <li>Knowledge of telecom circuits and associated technologies.</li> <li>Experience with databases, SQL concepts, and scripting.</li> <li>Understanding of software engineering, integrations, programming concepts, and/or database technologies.</li> <li>Experience serving as a technical subject matter expert, mentor, trainer, or escalation resource.</li> <li>Experience presenting or delivering technical training to large audiences.</li> <li>A highly analytical, inquisitive, collaborative, service-oriented mindset with an interest in emerging technologies.</li> </ul> <h3>What’s in it for you?</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting global company where teams work collaboratively to build innovative solutions and deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. You'll have the opportunity to work with leading contact center technology, partner with strategic customers, solve complex business and technical challenges, and influence how we continue improving our products and customer experience.</p> <h3>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX model, which enables maximum flexibility: two days working from the office and three days of remote work each week. of ethics.</li> </ul> <h3>Have you got what it takes?</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> data-wra="1">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Experience performing Windows and Linux operating system patching and maintenance activities.<span class="___xxxjie0 f1w7gpdv f1gqqdtu" data-wra="1">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Windows Domains, and DNS services.</li> <li>Experience operating within structured change management processes.</li> communication skills with technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership.</li> </ul> <h3>You will have an advantage if you also have:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience supporting PCI-DSS and/or Cyber f1gqqdtu" data-wra="1">&nbsp;</span></li> <li>Experience working with Okta identity and access management solutions.</li> <li>Experience coordinating hardware replacements and vendor-managed
