title: Manager, PreSales Engineering, AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what's the role all about?</strong></p> <p>NiCE Cognigy is looking for a Manager, PreSales Engineering, AI to lead our Sales Engineering team across three of our fastest-growing continental European markets: Benelux, France, and Nordics.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, frontline manager role. You'll stay close to the business - personally engaging in strategic deal support alongside your team - while carrying direct responsibility for market penetration, lead generation, and building thought leadership as we scale in these regions.</p> <p>You'll lead a team of 5-6 Sales Engineers who provide technical demos, support discovery calls, answer technical RFPs, and actively support events across Benelux, France, and Nordics, and you'll report to our Senior Director, PreSales Engineering, AI.</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a hands-on, frontline manager - staying close to the business and personally engaging in strategic deal support alongside your team, rather than managing from a distance.</li> <li>Own market penetration for Benelux, France, and Nordics, turning your team's efforts into sustained new-business growth across these emerging regions.</li> <li>Drive lead generation initiatives that build qualified pipeline in these markets, working closely with marketing and regional sales.</li> <li>Build and scale thought leadership for the team across Benelux, France, and Nordics, positioning Cognigy as a trusted authority as these regions grow.</li> <li>Lead the Sales Engineering team, making sure demo pitches and other activities are prioritized correctly.</li> <li>Take the presales lead on RFPs, making sure they're delivered on time together with the Bid Manager in region.</li> <li>Approach opportunities holistically - bridging technical capabilities with solution requirements and business impact, including customer experience and ROI.</li> <li>Support customer success with upsell opportunities by spotting strategic openings.</li> <li>Engage with a broad range of customer and partner stakeholders, from hands-on technical contacts to VP level, identifying champions and building relationships.</li> <li>Delegate work and prioritize team activities with full autonomy.</li> <li>Liaise with regional sales and customer success leaders.</li> <li>Stay on top of the competitive landscape, comparing our software with other conversational AI products on the market.</li> <li>Facilitate internal training so the team stays sharp and up to date.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in enterprise software, ideally with contact center or automation technologies - whether at a software company or building custom solutions.</li> <li>Proven “team lead” or manager experience: leading a team, running regular 1:1s, and genuinely understanding what your people need.</li> <li>The ability to coach individuals and build a high-performing team, backed by a solid foundational understanding of technology and AI.</li> <li>A drive to stay current and share knowledge across the team in a fast-changing environment.</li> <li>Comfort dealing with pressure - tight presentation deadlines, unexpected team gaps, and everything in between.</li> <li>Deep understanding of Conversational AI technologies, including GenAI, LLMs, speech-to-text (STT), and text-to-speech (TTS) solutions.</li> <li>Familiarity with agentic AI concepts such as RAG, MCP and A2A communication.</li> <li>Strong selling skills - qualifying opportunities, building rapport, and demonstrating NiCE Cognigy's value with confidence.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and lead a team successfully, including full people-management responsibilities.</li> <li>A curious, adaptable mindset - you stay on top of the latest trends in conversational AI and love learning new things.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for you?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:6,&quot;335551620&quot;:6,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:240,&quot;335572083&quot;:0,&quot;335572084&quot;:0,&quot;335572085&quot;:4278190080,&quot;469789810&quot;:&quot;nil&quot;}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams - comprised of the best of the best - work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><span data-teams="true"><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></span></p> <p>NICE, the market leader in cloud-based contact center technology, is looking for an experienced Solution Consultant to excite potential customers about its extensive portfolio and aid them in ultimately becoming a NICE customer.&nbsp; A successful Solution Consultant will work consultatively with prospects to identify their goals and business drivers, and creatively design a solution that will meet the ever-growing demands of their contact center needs. This position will provide dedicated sales support to the Enterprise, BPO and SMB sales teams by exceeding the below expectations. Hands on architects, with a flair of presenting, can do a Player / Coach role.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong> &nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Own Presales end-to-end: pipeline, solution strategy, POC governance, and win/loss review</li> <li>Lead on complex enterprise AI deals from first discovery through technical sign-off</li> <li>Design and oversee POCs — including data requirements, model evaluation, integration architecture, and results framing</li> <li>Coach Solutions Consultants on AI solutioning, technical storytelling, and commercial positioning</li> <li>Build repeatable playbooks, demo frameworks, and discovery guides specific to AI/ML products</li> <li>Feed structured field intelligence back into Product and GTM strategy</li> <li>Represent the company at industry events and in customer advisory conversations.</li> </ul> <p><span data-teams="true"><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong> &nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>12–16 years in Pre-Sales, Solution Consulting, or Sales Engineering — 3+ years leading a team</li> <li>Last 2+ years hands-on in AI product Pre-Sales — not adjacent to it, in it</li> <li>Working knowledge of the AI stack: LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, inference costs, token economics, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, and API-based AI services</li> <li>Able to scope and run technically rigorous POCs without needing an engineer to translate</li> <li>Commercial fluency around AI pricing models — tokens, compute, licensing, and total cost of ownership conversations with procurement and finance</li> <li>Deep experience with complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles</li> <li>A coach who leads by doing — you get in the deal, run the discovery, fix the demo, then debrief the team on why</li> <li>Ideal experience around 15-18 Years</li> <li>Has been in an Architect/ Gen AI front ending Technology role in the past 2-3 years&nbsp;</li> <li>Is conversational and understands Gen AI positioning and has exposure to banking, insurance, retail in similar profiles,</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong> &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr! &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enjoy NiCE-FLEX! </strong> &nbsp;</p> <p>At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. title: Head of Partners, APAC
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what's the role all about?</strong></p> <p>This is a senior leadership role for a commercially sharp, relationship-first partnerships executive who is ready to own APAC partner growth for NiCE. You will report directly into the VP Partner Sales, International, and lead a team of 8-10 partner managers across a region spanning India, Middle East, ANZ, Japan and South-East Asia. &nbsp;<br><br>APAC is at an inflection point for NiCE. Partner-led revenue is growing quickly, and this role exists to accelerate that momentum by building deeper strategic relationships, raising the execution quality of the team, and aligning the partner ecosystem to the AI-first CX transformation story that NiCE and Cognigy represent together. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong></p> <p><strong>Partner strategy and ecosystem development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and execute the APAC partner strategy, aligned to NiCE's international commercial objectives and partner-led revenue targets.</li> <li>Build and grow a high-performing partner ecosystem across GSIs, hyperscalers, regional system integrators, BPOs, and value-added resellers in India, Middle East, ANZ, Japan, and South-East Asia.</li> <li>Establish and deepen executive-level relationships with partner leadership across the region, leveraging your existing APAC network from day one.</li> <li>Work with hyperscaler partners AWS and Microsoft to develop co-sell, marketplace, and joint go-to-market motions that accelerate pipeline and deal velocity.</li> <li>Identify, qualify, and onboard new strategic partners where gaps exist in current ecosystem coverage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Revenue and pipeline ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline to meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets across APAC.</li> <li>Maintain full pipeline visibility through disciplined use of Salesforce and NiCE's partner operating cadence QBRs, MBRs, and weekly deal reviews.</li> <li>Build joint business plans with Tier 1 and Platinum partners, including clear revenue commitments, enablement milestones, and executive alignment.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with APAC sales leadership, marketing, and pre-sales to ensure partner opportunities convert and partners are fully equipped to close.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team leadership and performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 8-10 Partner Managers across APAC, setting clear performance standards and a high-execution culture.</li> <li>Build a team environment anchored on accountability, coaching, and continuous enablement with a focus on producing partner managers who can operate independently in market.</li> <li>Hire, onboard, and retain talent in line with APAC headcount plans as the function scales.</li> <li>Bring the energy and operating discipline to run a high-performing regional function, with a consistent rhythm of field engagement, pipeline reviews, and executive stakeholder management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI-first partner enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Champion NiCE's AI-first CX narrative CXone and Cognigy across the APAC partner ecosystem, ensuring partners can confidently position agentic AI to their customers.</li> <li>Drive structured enablement programmes across the region, including certifications, AI readiness training, and joint presales capability.</li> <li>Identify and develop partner-led reference customers and lighthouse accounts across India, ANZ, and Japan that demonstrate the NiCE and Cognigy value proposition.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Executive presence and market representation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent NiCE at major APAC industry events, partner summits, and customer forums across India, Australia, and Japan.</li> <li>Build and maintain senior relationships with partner C-suite and alliance leadership, acting as the face of NiCE's partner business in the region.</li> <li>Provide regular reporting and insight to the VP Partner Sales International on partner performance, pipeline health, market trends, and competitive intelligence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></p> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in partner sales, alliances, channel, or business development within a B2B SaaS or AI/CX business with significant tenure in APAC markets.</li> <li>A proven track record of building and scaling partner-led revenue across at least two of the three key markets: India, ANZ, and Japan.</li> <li>Hands-on experience leading and growing a team of 8+ partner managers in a complex, multi-country regional role.</li> <li>Deep working knowledge of GSI and hyperscaler operating models, with existing C-level and VP-level relationships across the APAC ecosystem.</li> <li>Demonstrable success in delivering against partner-sourced revenue targets in a fast-paced, commercially competitive environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong commercial instincts you understand how to structure partner programmes, protect deal economics, and align partner incentives to mutual growth.</li> <li>Credible AI and CX fluency you can speak with conviction about agentic AI, contact centre transformation, cloud platforms, and the practical outcomes NiCE delivers for enterprise customers.</li> <li>Exceptional executive presence and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust at C-suite and senior partner leadership level across diverse APAC cultures.</li> <li>High proficiency in pipeline management, sales cadence, and partner governance frameworks you run a clean, disciplined operating model.</li> <li>Cross-functional collaboration skills you work naturally with sales, marketing, product, and finance to align on shared outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to communicate and influence in English to board level; additional APAC language proficiency (Mandarin, Japanese) is a significant advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Background</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in CCaaS, contact centre AI, unified communications, CX platforms, or enterprise SaaS strongly preferred.</li> <li>Familiarity with partner programme design, deal registration, MDF allocation, and partner performance management.</li> <li>Experience working within a global matrix organisation, managing upward to international leadership and laterally with regional sales teams.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field. MBA or equivalent executive programme is advantageous.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

title: Senior AI Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>The team</strong></p> <p>NiCE&nbsp;Labs (nice.com/nice-labs) is where&nbsp;NiCE&nbsp;explores&nbsp;what's&nbsp;next in AI for customer experience. This role&nbsp;is on&nbsp;AI Innovation, the Labs pillar that builds and&nbsp;validates&nbsp;new AI capabilities through prototypes, so the company can make better product decisions, faster.<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We're&nbsp;a deliberately small, senior team of builders inside&nbsp;NiCE&nbsp;Cognigy, the AI agent platform. We operate in fast iteration cycles: spot an emerging capability, build a working prototype, validate it against real metrics (quality, latency, cost, user impact), and then&nbsp;decide:&nbsp;kill it, iterate, publish it, or hand it off to a product team. Some of our work is public, like the open-sourced&nbsp;Cognigy&nbsp;Platform MCP server; most of it shapes the product roadmap from the inside.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We hire&nbsp;for&nbsp;product mindset and builder mentality. Everyone on the team takes ideas from zero to working software, shows them to real users, and argues from evidence.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>You'll&nbsp;work at the intersection of frontier AI capabilities and a real enterprise product. The field moves faster than any roadmap can track. Your job is to close that gap: turn new models, protocols, and agent patterns into working systems, prove what matters in realistic scenarios, and produce the insights and reference implementations that let product and engineering teams move with confidence.<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You'll&nbsp;need to be comfortable with ambiguity, at home where best practices&nbsp;don't&nbsp;exist yet, and quick to move on when the results point elsewhere.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong><strong> </strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build agentic systems and full-stack prototypes end-to-end, shipping a first version in days and learning from real use</li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Track the frontier (new models, agent patterns, protocols like MCP) and turn the promising ones into working prototypes rather than slideware</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Design experiments that show whether a concept holds up, measured in quality, latency, cost, and user impact</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Work directly with internal users, product managers, and customers to validate concepts early and iterate quickly</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:100}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Turn validated prototypes into reference implementations and write-ups that product teams can build on, then hand off cleanly and move to the next bet</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Give product and platform teams concrete feedback on where AI capabilities shine and where they fall short</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Move between initiatives as priorities shift. What you learn on one bet compounds into the next</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Have 4+ years building full-stack software, including things you started from nothing. We weigh what you've shipped more than years on a CV<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:100}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Have shipped LLM-powered systems to&nbsp;production:features real users depended on, not demos or notebooks</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:100}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Understand AI agents below the framework level: message arrays, tool calling, context management, prompt caching. You could build an agent loop from scratch and explain why it works</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as your default way of working, and it makes you measurably faster, not just busier</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Are&nbsp;full-stackin practice: comfortable taking a prototype from API to demo UI on your own (our stack centers on TypeScript/Node.js and React)</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:100}">&nbsp;</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Do your best work when the ground is still moving. New territory energises you more than a settled plan</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Think in user problems first, solutions second</span></li> </ul> <p>You will have an advantage if you also have:</p> <ul> <li>A strong eye for UX/UI: you can make a prototype feel like a product, and you notice when one lacks that eye</li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Experience with voice and real-time AI: streaming, speech-to-text/text-to-speech, voice-to-voice models</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Open-source work on agent tooling (MCP servers, harnesses, evals)</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Experience designing evaluations for AI systems</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto"> Background in conversational AI or customer-experience products</span></li> </ul> <p data-ccp-border-top="0px none " data-ccp-padding-top="0px" data-ccp-border-bottom="0px none " data-ccp-padding-bottom="0px"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Enjoy NICE-FLEX!&nbsp;</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240,&quot;335572083&quot;:0,&quot;335572084&quot;:0,&quot;335572085&quot;:4278190080,&quot;469789810&quot;:&quot;nil&quot;}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p data-ccp-border-top="0px none " data-ccp-padding-top="0px"><span data-contrast="auto">At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><h4><strong>So what's the role all about?</strong></h4> <p>The Senior Trust Analyst — UK Sovereign sits at the intersection of security, sales, and customer success, serving as the primary trust and security point of contact for our UK Sovereign customers. This role owns the response to customer security inquiries and questionnaires, supports contract reviews on security and privacy terms, and acts as a trusted advisor on the security posture of our UK Sovereign environments.</p> <p>In addition to traditional Trust Analyst responsibilities, this role serves as the dedicated liaison between UK Sovereign technical security teams and customers, ensuring transparency, trust, and proactive communication. The Senior Trust Analyst will track and report vulnerability remediation activities in a structured Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&amp;M) format, deliver regular security status updates, and translate complex technical information into clear, customer-ready communications.</p> <p>This is a senior, customer-facing position critical to building and sustaining trust with UK government and regulated sector customers, accelerating deal cycles, and reinforcing the integrity of our UK Sovereign security program.</p> <h4>How will you make an impact?</h4> <h2>Customer Trust &amp; Security Engagement</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor: </strong>Serve as the primary point of contact for UK Sovereign customers on all matters related to security posture, vulnerabilities, remediation activities, and trust documentation.</li> <li><strong>Security Questionnaires: </strong>Support end-to-end responses to customer and prospect security questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, VSA, MoD/UK government questionnaires, and bespoke enterprise formats), ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent answers tailored to UK Sovereign context.</li> <li><strong>Responder: </strong>Help respond to inbound customer security inquiries via email and ticketing, translating technical controls into clear business language for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Trust Portal &amp; Documentation: </strong>Maintain the public trust center and UK Sovereign customer-facing documentation, ensuring security whitepapers, certifications, and standard responses remain current and reusable.</li> </ul> <h2>Security Posture &amp; Vulnerability Reporting</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Security Posture Assessment: </strong>Collaborate closely with UK Sovereign technical and engineering teams to understand and assess the current security posture of UK Sovereign environments.</li> <li><strong>POA&amp;M Reporting: </strong>help support vulnerability remediation status in a structured Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&amp;M) format, documenting identified vulnerabilities, planned remediation steps, responsible parties, target completion dates, and progress against agreed timelines.</li> <li><strong>Monthly Customer Reporting: </strong>help prepare and<strong> </strong>deliver monthly security status updates to UK Sovereign customers, including progress on scheduled remediation items and key security metrics.</li> <li><strong>Remediation Oversight: </strong>Monitor and track remediation activities across engineering and security teams, ensuring alignment with agreed timelines and compliance requirements.</li> </ul> <h2>Audit</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Audit Interpretation: </strong>Read and interpret third-party audit reports (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, penetration test summaries) and represent findings to customers in questionnaires and security responses.</li> </ul> <h2>Communication &amp; Stakeholder Management</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Information Translation: </strong>Gather detailed technical information from engineering and security teams, then convert and filter it into clear, concise, and structured updates accessible to both technical experts and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Customer Meetings: </strong>participate in security review meetings, capture feedback and action items, and ensure timely follow-up and resolution by technical teams.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Coordination: </strong>Coordinate input from internal teams to validate questionnaire answers and resolve gaps between stated controls and operational reality.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Citizenship &amp; Clearance: </strong>UK citizenship and ability to pass and maintain SC clearance.</li> <li><strong>Experience: </strong>5+ years in a security, GRC, trust, or technical customer-facing role, with direct ownership of security questionnaires, customer inquiries, and security reporting.</li> <li><strong>Questionnaire Expertise: </strong>Hands-on experience responding to SIG, CAIQ, VSA, and bespoke enterprise/government security questionnaires.</li> <li><strong>Compliance Knowledge: </strong>Working knowledge of Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and at least one of PCI DSS, GDPR/UK GDPR, HIPAA, or FedRAMP.</li> <li><strong>Technical Expertise: </strong>Strong technical understanding of security principles, architecture, and vulnerability management, including access control, encryption, incident response, network security, and secure SDLC.</li> <li><strong>Cloud &amp; SaaS: </strong>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security models.</li> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li><strong>Discretion: </strong>Proven ability to handle confidential customer and company information with integrity and discretion.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Professional cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSK, ISO 27001
